issues: Radix warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` on DialogContent (also flagged in iter64).

critical_code_review_comments: projections_module.projections_vs_actual: actual revenue aggregation is hard-coded to current calendar year (date.today().year=2026). Year-1 projection months (Jul→Mar) are matched to 2026 calendar months regardless of when 'Year 1' actually starts — will silently misalign if Year-1 begins mid-2025 or later. Consider adding a start-date offset per year, or a `year_start_month` config.
actual_net_income uses a hard-coded 40% COGS assumption. UI text notes this, but a per-product COGS aggregation would be more accurate for FM.
SalonsPanel: districtFilter is derived from currently-loaded salons only; if list is paginated/filtered by status, some districts disappear from the dropdown. Fine for MVP.

ProjectionsPanel table only shows a subset of projected months for Year-1 (9 rows in DB vs 12 in Y2/Y3) — parser only picks months where sales>0 in the sheet, which matches Year-1 sheet content (partial year). Good behaviour but worth noting to the user in UI (optional).
Escape-key close on salon-detail-dialog works, no console errors during projections load or year switch.
